task.title: HealthKit Build 59 Sep24 Training Detail failure diagnostic + deferred-Cardio inventory

result.summary: Claude ran a bounded, read-only diagnostic on the Founder's Build 59 report that Sep24 Training Detail fails to load ('This session could not be loaded') while Sep23 is healthy. Root cause proven with certainty by running the real production presentation code against production-validated fixtures and reading the real installed Native DTO source: a client-side Swift Codable decode failure in TrainingReadModel.swift, whose Relationship struct declares confirmedAt as a required non-optional field, which the intentional, correct 'candidate' relationship shape (introduced for unconfirmed HK Strength matches) never populates. Server behavior is correct and unchanged; fix is Native-only. Also completed a full deferred-Cardio-observation inventory, which found 2 additional deferred Sep23 Indoor Walks beyond the 2 previously-known Sep24 ones (4 total). No patch, deploy, policy mutation, or Cardio activation occurred.

blockers: Sep24 Training Detail is currently broken for the Founder on installed Build 59 until the Native-only fix above is implemented, tested, released, and installed.
unexpected_findings: The candidate/confirmed HK Strength presentation projection introduced in ca21aa26 (Part B) produces a genuinely different, and correct, JSON shape for an unconfirmed candidate (status, matchOutcome, confidence -- no confirmedAt) versus a confirmed relationship (status, confirmedAt) -- but the pre-existing Native DTO (written before the candidate concept existed) declares confirmedAt as required and non-optional, so any candidate-shaped response fails to decode entirely, taking down the whole session detail screen rather than just omitting the HK provenance block.

The one existing Native test that touches this model (TrainingSessionDetailPresentationTests.swift) hand-constructs the Swift struct directly rather than decoding real JSON, so it structurally could not have caught this contract mismatch -- no test anywhere in the Native suite exercises a real JSONDecoder pass over a candidate-shaped payload.

September 23 has the identical cardio-strength-cardio workout pattern September 24 does, with two additional deferred Indoor Walk observations that no prior report (including the original forensic reconciliation) had identified -- the deferred-Cardio backlog is 4 observations across 2 days, not 2.

Three already-canonicalized workouts (2 cardio, 1 strength) were found dated 2026-09-22, predating the current Strength-only workout policy's effective date -- independently investigated and confirmed benign: they canonicalized under an earlier, no-longer-live policy configuration and, per this codebase's terminal-canonicalization design, were never retroactively affected by the later narrowing. The live policy was independently re-verified unchanged; this is not evidence of any unauthorized Cardio activation.
